atlases.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production game illustration atlas 1 of 8. Create one large contact sheet, EXACTLY 4 columns × 2 rows, 8 perfectly equal rectangular PORTRAIT cells, no gaps, each cell about 2:3 aspect ratio. Sheet aspect ratio 4:3. Each cell is an independent full-bleed card ILLUSTRATION, not a completed card. The reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its hand-engraved dark storybook graphic novel woodcut print style, scratchy rich crosshatching, blue-black night shadows, tarnished gold/amber lantern lighting, sophisticated matte ink texture. Tiny jagged ink edges, not chunky low-resolution pixel art, not smooth plastic or 3D. Rich scene depth inside each small composition, excellent readable silhouettes. Background of every cell deep midnight navy #152536; dynamic subjects kept in middle 75%, dark quiet top 12% and bottom 14% for UI overlay. No text, NO NUMBERS, no border, no badges, no labels, no white gutters, no letters or logos. Do not add people unless explicitly specified. Basic skills only objects/hands, never whole characters. Each subject has its own element palette (ice blue, poison green, purple, copper) without losing overall blue-and-amber storybook family. Exact row-major subjects, left-to-right top row then bottom row: CELL 1: One antique iron street lantern glowing gold, suspended in darkness; this is the same angular capped lantern as the reference, small light motes gathering; CELL 2: Two gloved forearms crossed behind a solid round iron shield, teal halo; CELL 3: One gloved hand projecting a single concentrated amber energy orb, a sharp comet trail; CELL 4: Two gloved hands sending TWO distinct amber energy orbs side by side, twin trails; CELL 5: One armored fist punching forward through six angular fragments, copper slash; CELL 6: A broad bronze sword cleaving a blue iron shield in two, purple streak; CELL 7: A four-point luminous amethyst star piercing layers of dark cloud; CELL 8: A faceted violet crystal exploding with controlled gold and purple rays. Grid edges must align perfectly at 25%,50%,75% width and50% height. Ensure complete eachsubject contained within its own cell. No overlaps between cells.
